label: Bitstamp

adapter.terms: Public market data; docs: 'All clients can make 400 requests per second. There is a default limit threshold of 10,000 requests per 10 minutes in place.' The server stays far below (1 request/second).

list_markets.note: GET /api/v2/markets/ returns every market at once (no paging documented); the server sorts by symbol and pages locally (page/limit). `query` is not sent: the API has no text search (its only filter is `entity`). symbol is Bitstamp's url symbol, e.g. btcusd.

get_ticker.note: symbol is the market_symbol from list_markets, e.g. btcusd or etheur. Prices in the counter currency; volume is the last 24h volume in the base currency.

get_candles.note: interval is one of 1m, 3m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 6h, 12h, 1d, 3d (the documented step values 60…259200 seconds); returns the latest `limit` candles (max 1000), oldest first. time is the candle open in UTC.

not_offered.me: No keyless account endpoint; every account call needs the X-Auth API-key + HMAC-SHA256 X-Auth-Signature headers (security schemes in https://www.bitstamp.net/api/). This entry serves public market data only.
not_offered.get_balances: POST /api/v2/account_balances/ requires the X-Auth / X-Auth-Signature authentication; no credentials available — public-data entry only.
not_offered.list_orders: POST /api/v2/open_orders/ requires the X-Auth / X-Auth-Signature authentication; public-data entry only.
not_offered.place_order: POST /api/v2/buy/{market_symbol}/ and /api/v2/sell/{market_symbol}/ require authentication and spend money; not mapped in this public-data entry.
not_offered.cancel_order: POST /api/v2/cancel_order/ requires the X-Auth / X-Auth-Signature authentication; not mapped in this public-data entry.

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances

terms_note: Spec vs live (2026-09-27): spot tickers (GET /api/v2/ticker/btcusd/) omit the derivatives fields the spec lists (mark_price, index_price, open_interest, open_interest_value) and do not repeat the symbol, so the symbol is echoed from the argument; GET /api/v2/markets/ spot records omit spec keys such as asset_class, tick_size, max_leverage and are not ordered by symbol; an unknown market answers HTTP 404 on /ticker/ and /ohlc/ (the spec documents no error response for it).
